subject.title: fix: resolve Tavily SecretRefs in agent tools

question: Should this broader PR be the canonical landing for both the Tavily fallback and agent Tool Search runtime-snapshot repair, or should maintainers land the narrower Tavily PR and split the agent repair into separate work?
rationale: Both open branches are proof-positive and overlap on credential behavior, while only this PR contains the additional agent-runtime fix; automation cannot safely choose which contributor branch and scope maintainers want to own.

options.title: Land the combined repair
options.body: Refresh this PR onto current main, require green exact-head gates, merge it, and close or retarget the overlapping Tavily-only PR.

options.title: Split the two repairs
options.body: Land https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/95110 for Tavily and request a separate focused PR for the agent Tool Search runtime-snapshot path.

recommendation.title: Land the combined repair
recommendation.body: Refresh this PR onto current main, require green exact-head gates, merge it, and close or retarget the overlapping Tavily-only PR.

likelyOwner.reason: They are assigned, integrated the current branch revision, and are best positioned to choose the canonical landing path.
